what: Small 0.1 Main-final (Δ=0.02695) condition-identity 2x2 decomposition. Third point of the Small-side FS–Δ curve (P0-5), same harness / n / alpha grid as the Bootstrap-final and C2 runs.
harness: offline forward only (teacher-forced), same 2000-window val loader and same launch script as the Bootstrap-final run; bare add, no γ, no training

protocol.shuffle: torch.roll(shifts=1) on the val batch; shift=2 as permutation null

checkpoint.recipe: Small 0.1 Main (chunks 1-4 -> main-final), bare add, no gamma

judging_floor.rule: floor = max(3*|null|, retest_diff); retest_diff = 3e-5 measured on Base

verdict_for_this_point.statement: At Δ=0.02695 fs_sector is -2.55e-6: 11.8x below the global 3e-5 floor and 23x below its own 3*|null| (5.89e-5). Still pure noise. fs_size (-5.13e-5) is the first quantity on the Small curve to clear its own floor (4.36e-5) at all, but only by 1.18x, and this harness has no per-window sd, so it is suggestive rather than resolved.

fs_delta_curve.purpose: P0-5: Small-side FS(Δ) reference curve, same harness, >=3 distinct Δ

shape.sector: flat in noise from Δ=0.0084 to 0.0270 (|fs_sector| <= 1.2e-5, three points, all below the 3e-5 floor), then jumps to -5.58e-4 at Δ=0.0749. The only resolved sector point is C2.
shape.delta_measured: |fs_sector| decreases across the three noise points (1.21e-5 -> 9.23e-6 -> 2.55e-6), which is scatter, not a real decline: all three are below their own permutation null or within one null-width. Do NOT fit a slope through them.
shape.implied_exponent: 2.73 (Bootstrap-final -> C2) or 5.27 (Main-final -> C2); the exponent is unstable because the low-Δ points are not resolved. Only the qualitative claim (strongly superlinear, no measurable identity below Δ≈0.03) is supported.
shape.upper_bound: for Δ <= 0.027, |fs_sector| < 1.2e-5 (envelope of the three noise points)

fs_delta_curve.p0_5_status: SATISFIED for point count (3 Small points + Base cross-check = 4 distinct Δ). The curve's low-Δ leg is a measured upper bound rather than a fitted line, because at Δ < 0.03 the sector identity is not separable on this harness at n=2000. Getting a resolved low-Δ point would need either a much bigger n or a model that has already grown the channel.

readings.sector_still_absent: fs_sector is -2.55e-6, i.e. 0.04x its own floor (5.89e-5). At Δ=0.027 the sector identity channel is still not there.
readings.size_is_the_first_channel_to_show: fs_size -5.13e-5 clears its own floor (4.36e-5) by only 1.18x, and is 94% of fs_both. It is the first point on the curve where any channel clears its floor at all, and it is size, not sector — directionally consistent with C2 where size is 3x sector, but too marginal to call resolved.
readings.gamma_still_does_not_help: alpha=8 reaches fs_sector -4.33e-5 (1.4x floor) for 6.9e-5 of CE. Same signature as Bootstrap-final and Base: the sector vector behaves like a small bias correction at these Δ.
readings.additivity_holds_here: fs_sector + fs_size = -5.39e-5 vs fs_both = -5.46e-5, residual +6.6e-7 — near-perfect additivity, better than the Bootstrap-final run (residual -1.8e-5) and comparable to C2 (-1.1e-5 on effects 100x larger).
readings.no_decline_in_the_channel: the apparent drop of |fs_sector| from 9.2e-6 (Δ=0.0167) to 2.6e-6 (Δ=0.027) is scatter: both are far below the floor and below their own permutation null. Do not report it as the channel weakening.
readings.caveat: single checkpoint, n=2000, one permutation pair, no per-window sd / ci95 in this harness, no lr_at_eval (nothing trained).

boundary: forward only; no training; model/ and finetune/ untouched; live Bootstrap untouched; Small production freeze untouched.
